what: Two blaze-diagnostics test fixtures lack a lang item real core always has, and hir-ty (as rustc) then rejects the program; fix the fixtures, not hir-ty (from db, 01483 items 2 and 4). (1) tests::lints::names::dead::lint_dead_code_3 uses core: "coerce_unsized" only. `&self` is a dispatchable receiver only through `DispatchFromDyn` (hir-ty dyn_compatibility.rs:600, rustc receiver_is_dispatchable returns false without the lang item), so `inner::Trait` is not dyn compatible and `&1_isize` to `&dyn inner::Trait` is E0308. Use core: "coerce_unsized, dispatch_from_dyn". (2) tests::lints::names::items::runtime_symbols: FFI_STD (items.rs:49) has no `#[lang = "va_list"] pub struct VaList<'a>` in core::ffi, so the C-variadic `_: ...` of `bcmp` has no VaList type (hir-ty infer.rs resolve_va_list) and gets E0282. Add the lang item struct to FFI_STD.
